node.statement: From 1.1.1, Y=X^2-I satisfies Y1=X^2 1-1=X1-1=0, ||Y||_{inf->inf}<=4 eta, and ||X||_{inf->inf}<=3. If eta<=1/8 then ||Y||<=1/2<1, so the binomial series B=sum_{m>=0} binom(-1/2,m)Y^m converges absolutely in operator norm. Because B is the norm limit of polynomials in Y=X^2-I, it commutes with X. Since Y1=0, Y^m1=0 for all m>=1, hence B1=1.
